items.question: What is the difference between Energy Healing and Reiki?
items.answer: Reiki is a specific method of Energy Healing. When I offer “Energy Healing”, it refers to my personal offering that has been shaped by my diverse learning experiences and growth, allowing me to tune into your unique needs in the moment to facilitate a deeply personalised treatment. When you come for “Reiki” specifically, I offer a treatment according to the principles of Reiki Jin Kei Do, the path of compassion and wisdom. This may be suitable for you if you want a full-body session, rather than a deep-dive into a specific issue.

items.question: What is an Energy Healing session like?
items.answer: Healing is deeply restful and restorative, and can be a meaningful and transformative experience. I’ll ask about your current complaints and past ailments. During the Healing you remain fully clothed and lie on a treatment table while I address imbalances in the energy body, applying gentle touch. Of course, if you prefer not to be touched, this is completely respected and I can work just above the body.

items.question: I don’t believe in energy – can this treatment still help me?
items.answer: Yes, with curiosity and an openness to your own experience, this treatment can still have a profound impact on your life and wellbeing. I highly prioritise meeting each other on mutual ground to facilitate a therapeutic relationship in which you feel comfortable expressing yourself without the need for “spiritual” terminology. What matters are the feelings, sensations and experiences that Healing evokes and how *you* relate to them. I will not enforce any beliefs on you.

items.question: Is this (psycho)therapy?
items.answer:
This is **not** psychotherapy and cannot replace psychiatric or medical care. Energy Healing (and counselling) can greatly complement, but not replace, care you receive from licensed health providers.

I hold a MSc in Clinical Psychology and my work is informed by both evidence-based and non-scientific approaches. The counselling component can thus facilitate therapeutic work but is **not** intended to serve as psychological therapy.

items.question: What can you help me with?
items.answer:
Together we can address whatever is occupying your heart, mind or body. Feel free to [reach out](contact) for an introductory call if you are unsure. Some examples of topics I typically work with are:

- Cultivating self-awareness of your inner processes and an embodied relationship with your emotions.
- Feeling ungrounded, lacking a sense of belonging or purpose. Finding yourself in times of transition.
- Difficulty expressing yourself or speaking your truth.
- Somatic complaints or tension held in the body, fatigue.
- A desire to connect to your soul or true self. Wanting to connect to your life-source, the universe or feel at peace and with one-ness.
- Feeling unloved or unlovable, not good enough or disappointed in yourself.
- Emotional disconnection, a lack of energy, fear of letting people close to seeing “the real you”.
- What the womb holds. Emotional, somatic and energetic imprints or scars relating to sex, miscarriage, birthing.

items.question: Who might this not be suitable for?
items.answer:
As any healing or therapeutic work, this may not be best suited for you if you are looking for a quick fix. Transformational change is a journey that requires your active collaboration.

Energy Healing is generally not recommended for people with a history of psychosis, schizophrenia or dissociative disorders.

items.question: How much do sessions cost?
items.answer:
- Introductory Call | 20 mins | Free
- Healing Treatment | 60 mins | €50 per session (€40 reduced rate*)
- Healing and Counselling | 90 mins | €75 per session (€60 reduced rate*)

* For students and those experiencing financial constraints. Please choose the rate that best reflects your current circumstances.

items.question: How often do sessions take place?
items.answer:
This is ultimately your choice and we can decide together based on your goals and needs. Healing is ongoing and dynamic, so we can reevaluate and change the frequency at any time.

I recommend starting with meeting once every other week. This gives you time in between sessions to integrate, reflect and process your experiences from the previous Healing session while maintaining consistency to support a therapeutic journey.

Healing is a process in which deeper layers are resolved with each treatment, so I recommend at least four sessions. That said, even a single treatment can bring profound relief and one-off sessions are welcome.

items.question: What if I need to cancel a session?
items.answer: If you need to cancel or reschedule a session, I kindly ask that you let me know at least 24 hours ahead of the planned appointment to avoid the late cancellation fee.

items.question: Can I get my sessions reimbursed?
items.answer: I work privately and independently from Dutch health insurance companies. Partial reimbursement may be available to you from private insurance “complementary health” or an employer’s “personal development fund”. I always provide you with an invoice that you can submit if you choose.
